summary.text: Nat Smith is the Democratic candidate for Minnesota State Senate District 33 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he has focused his legal career on combating fraud and protecting whistleblowers and employees.

paragraphs.text: Smith's Ballotpedia profile lists a bachelor's degree from the University of Minnesota and a law degree from William Mitchell College of Law, and gives his profession as attorney.
In the survey, he said he lives in Stillwater with his wife, their newborn daughter and their dog, and that he serves on committees for both the City of Stillwater and Washington County.

Smith said his priorities include rooting out waste and fraud in government spending, affordable health care and child care, well-funded public schools, support for small businesses, and protecting the St. Croix River Valley.
He named Senator Tina Smith, Save the Boundary Waters Action Fund and MAPE among his endorsers.
His Democratic primary was canceled, and he advanced to the general election without appearing on the primary ballot.
